pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍentā pesale bhikkhū omasanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.3: jātiyāpi nāmena pi gottena pi kammena pi sippena pi ābādhena pi liṅgena pi kilesena pi āpattiyāpi hīnena pi akkosena khuṃsenti vambhenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍentā pesale bhikkhū omasissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ --la--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍentā pesale bhikkhū omasatha jātiyāpi . . . khuṃsetha vambhethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā pesalehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ bhaṇḍentā pesale bhikkhū omasissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Takkasilāyaṃ aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa Nandivisālo nāma balibaddo ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.2: atha kho bhikkhave Nandivisālo balibaddo taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.3: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ sahassena abbhutaṃ karohi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.5: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ sahassena abbhutaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.7: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sakaṭasataṃ atibandhitvā Nandivisālaṃ balibaddaṃ yuñjitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.9: atha kho bhikkhave Nandivisālo balibaddo tatth' eva aṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.10: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sahassena parājito pajjhāyi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.11: atha kho bhikkhave Nandivisālo balibaddo taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.13: tathā hi panāhaṃ bho tayā sahassena parājito 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.14: kissa pana maṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa akūṭaṃ kūṭavādena pāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.15: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ dvīhi sahassehi abbhutaṃ karohi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.17: mā ca maṃ akūṭaṃ kūṭavādena pāpesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.18: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo seṭṭhinā saddhiṃ dvīhi sahassehi abbhutaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.20: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo sakaṭasataṃ atibandhitvā Nandivisālaṃ balibaddaṃ yuñjitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.22: atha kho bhikkhave Nandivisālo balibaddo sakaṭasataṃ atibaddhaṃ pavaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.29: tadāpi me bhikkhave amanāpā khuṃsanā vambhanā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.30: kim aṅga pana etarahi manāpā bhavissati khuṃsanā vambhanā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.31: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:1.2.32: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.2: dasahi ākārehi omasati: jātiyāpi nāmena pi gottena pi kammena pi sippena pi ābādhena pi liṅgena pi kilesena pi āpattiyāpi akkosena pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.4: dve jātiyo, hīnā ca jāti ukkaṭṭhā ca jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.6: caṇḍālajāti veṇajāti nesādajāti rathakārajāti pukkusajāti, esā hīnā nāma jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.8: khattiyajāti brāhmaṇajāti, esā ukkaṭṭhā nāma jāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.10: dve nāmāni, hīnañ ca nāmaṃ ukkaṭṭhañ ca nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.12: Avakaṇṇakaṃ Javakaṇṇakaṃ Dhaniṭṭhakaṃ Saviṭṭhakaṃ Kulavaḍḍhakaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittikataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.14: buddhapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ saṃghapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittikataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.16: dve gottāni, hīnañ ca gottaṃ ukkaṭṭhañ ca gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.18: Kosiyagottaṃ Bhāradvājagottaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ avaññātaṃ hīḷitaṃ paribhūtaṃ acittikataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.20: Gotamagottaṃ Moggallānagottaṃ Kaccāyanagottaṃ Vāsiṭṭhagottaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ . . . cittikataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma gottaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.22: dve kammāni, hīnañ ca kammaṃ ukkaṭṭhañ ca kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.24: koṭṭhakakammaṃ pupphachaḍḍakakammaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ . . . acittikataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.26: kasi vāṇijjā gorakkhā tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ . . . cittikataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma kammaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.28: dve sippāni, hīnañ ca sippaṃ ukkaṭṭhañ ca sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.30: naḷakārasippaṃ kumbhakārasippaṃ pesakārasippaṃ cammakārasippaṃ nahāpitasippaṃ tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu oññātaṃ . . . acittikataṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.32: muddā gaṇanā lekhā tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ . . . cittikataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma sippaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.36: dve liṅgāni, hīnañ ca liṅgaṃ ukkaṭṭhañ ca liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.38: atidīghaṃ atirassaṃ atikaṇhaṃ accodātaṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.40: nātidīghaṃ nātirassaṃ nātikaṇhaṃ n' accodātaṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.44: hīnā, api ca sotāpatti samāpatti ukkaṭṭhā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.46: dve akkosā, hīno ca akkoso ukkaṭṭho ca akkoso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.48: oṭṭho 'si, meṇḍo 'si, goṇo 'si, gadrabho 'si, tiracchānagato 'si, nerayiko 'si, n' atthi tuyhaṃ sugati, duggati yeva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā 'ti, yakārena vā, bhakārena vā, kāṭakoṭacikāya vā, eso hīno nāma akkoso.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.1.50: paṇḍito 'si, byatto 'si, medhāvī 'si, bahussuto 'si, dhammakathiko 'si, n' atthi tuyhaṃ duggati, sugati yeva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā 'ti, eso ukkaṭṭho nāma akkoso. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.2.1: upasampanno upasampannaṃ khuṃsetukāmo vambhetukāmo maṅkuṃ kattukāmo hīnena hīnaṃ vadeti caṇḍālaṃ veṇaṃ nesādaṃ rathakāraṃ pukkusaṃ, caṇḍālo 'si veṇo 'si nesādo 'si rathakāro 'si pukkuso 'sīti bhaṇati, āpatti vācāya vācāya pācittiyassa.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.2.6: Avakaṇṇako 'si . . . Kulavaḍḍhako 'sīti bhaṇati, āpatti vācāya vācāya pācittiyassa.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2:2.8.11: na mayaṃ paṇḍitā byattā medhāvī bahussutā dhammakathikā n' atth' amhākaṃ duggati sugati yeva amhākaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā 'ti bhaṇati, āpatti vācāya vācāya dubbhāsitassa. ||8||
